evidence: log loss +0.0130 (95% interval +0.0046 to +0.0209). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

372 picks, ROI -0.3% (95% interval -7.8% to +7.0%), win rate 59.1% against a break-even 58.9%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 25% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.11 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,909 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,768; a 1% edge takes 44,179. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
